metadata.architect_diagnosis: Existing setup.attributes.create_attribute already covers deterministic driver/show attribute creation, including min/max and bool types. No reusable proxy/connect boundary existed, so added injectable proxy attribute and non-destructive visibility wiring primitives. Existing proxy attrs/connections are rejected rather than silently replaced; partial attribute cleanup remains a higher Scene transaction concern.
metadata.owner_constraint: Do not use Codex until the owner explicitly re-enables it.

metadata.purpose: Prove reusable proxy-attribute and visibility-wiring contracts before final BSSequence Scene transaction composition.
acceptance: Compile/import attributes, proxy_attributes and smoke, then run ProxyAttributesSmokeTest.
Verify Maya proxy addAttr uses source plug, visibility wiring targets .visibility, and existing target attrs/incoming visibility connections are rejected non-destructively.
Retain setup.attributes.create_attribute for BSSequence-specific float 0..10 and bool show attribute creation; do not duplicate it.
Do not claim Maya runtime parity; do not use Codex.
metadata.next_if_pass: Architect closes final Setup dependency and implements an injectable BSSequence Scene transaction that composes proven sampling, blendShape, SDK, attribute/proxy/visibility boundaries with explicit currentTime/driver restoration and cleanup behavior, then queues focused Python transaction smoke.
metadata.owner_constraint: Do not use Codex until the owner explicitly re-enables it.
